indications.description: Treatment of advanced (unresectable or metastatic) melanoma in adults.
First-line treatment of adult patients with unresectable or advanced hepatocellular carcinoma.

treatment.schedule_summary: Cycles 1–4: nivolumab 1 mg/kg IV and ipilimumab 3 mg/kg IV day 1 every 21 days. From cycle 5, choose nivolumab 240 mg IV or 600 mg SC every 14 days, or 480 mg IV or 1200 mg SC every 28 days. Melanoma first maintenance: wait 3 weeks for q 14 or 6 weeks for q 28; HCC: wait 3 weeks for either. Melanoma continues until progression/unacceptable toxicity; HCC monotherapy up to 24 months.
treatment.duration_text: Four combination cycles, then indication-specific nivolumab monotherapy; no fixed total cycle count for advanced melanoma.

eligibility: Adults with an NCCP-listed indication; ECOG 0–2; adequate haematological, hepatic and renal function.
Advanced melanoma: determine baseline BRAF status.
HCC only: first-line unresectable/advanced disease; Child-Pugh score 5 or 6.
Pregnancy or lack of effective contraception requires consultant assessment of benefit versus risk; effective contraception for at least 5 months after the last nivolumab dose.
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to the drug(s) or excipients; follow the current NCCP source for all exclusions and cautions.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Highest active parenteral component is ipilimumab, classified as low emetogenic risk in NCCP SACT Antiemetic Guidance V 6 Table 7.

phase_plans.source: NCCP 00431p 9: ipilimumab low; nivolumab minimal; local antiemetic policy.

supportive_care.immune_toxicity_note: High-dose steroids and other immunosuppression are specialist toxicity treatment, not routine prophylaxis. Taper after improvement over at least 1 month; opportunistic-infection prophylactic antibiotics during immunosuppression per consultant/local guidance.

administration.note: Infuse over 30 minutes. Vital signs every 30 minutes during and for 1 hour after infusion.
